ONGUSDT (43 cells, 10.0%) exceeds the per-symbol bound and is FLAGGED_HOLE_HEAVY: runnable, but expected to refuse decisions under the window rule below; its flags are recorded per decision
amended_rules.hole_handling_in_features_and_decisions: feature windows compute over available staged rows only; if a feature's lookback window contains more than 10% missing metrics-day cells for that symbol, every decision for that symbol on that date is REFUSED (no position, no fill); refusals are recorded in a per-arm refusal registry; a refused decision never becomes a fill and never synthesizes data
amended_rules.funding_sanity_bound: |funding_rate| <= 0.0375 (documented extreme cap); measured floor events at -0.02 are legitimate data and enter costs normally
amended_rules.nothing_else_changes: universe stays the frozen 20 symbols; MEASURED_BOUND_LAG_3D unchanged; all stage-A gates unchanged
